study_identification_part.si_4_title: Cortical thickness and grey-matter volume anomaly detection in individual MRI scans: Comparison of two methods

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: OASIS-3 dataset used for both normative modeling and clinical evaluation.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The OASIS3 dataset (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies, LaMontagne et al., 2019) is publicly available at www.oasis-brains.org/
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: study_1/Romascano2024.pdf.md: Materials and methods / OASIS3 dataset, Paragraph 1

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: 1,927 scans from 696 non-converting subjects (CDR=0) used for normative models. 209 scans (CDR>=1) and 420 scans (CDR=0.5) used for evaluation. 87 scans from 41 converters used for longitudinal analysis.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Of the 2'014 HC scans, 87 are from 41 subjects that had a mixture of scans with CDR = 0 and CDR >= 0.5 ... Those scans were excluded from building our normative model, which was therefore based on 1'927 scans from 696 non-converting subjects ... The 41 'converter' subjects were instead used to investigate the change trajectories ... The AD dataset consisted of 209 scans with CDR >= 1.0.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/Romascano2024.pdf.md: Materials and methods / OASIS3 dataset, Paragraph 2 & Results / Application to AD patients, Paragraph 1

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Overall phase refers to the initial selection of HC scans (CDR=0, non-converters). Train phase refers to the scans remaining after cleaning (removing 99 outlier scans). The same set of scans was used for both models after cleaning.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: based on 1'927 scans from 696 non-converting subjects ... The 99 HC scans ... were removed before our final normative models were built from the of 1'828 remaining HC scans.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: study_1/Romascano2024.pdf.md: Materials and methods / OASIS3 dataset, Paragraph 2 & Results / Cleaning the normative models, Paragraph 2
